name: build_graph
description: Build the call graph for a project directory. Must be called before get_call_hierarchy, analyze_impact, or check_architecture.

directory.description: Path to project directory to analyze (default: current working directory)

BasisDto.description: PRF-ANA-06: provenance basis for a build_graph result.

complete.description: `true` only when every identity component was established.

config_digest.description:
Digest over the effective configuration relevant to the build.
Stable across identical configurations; changes when config changes.

source_manifest_digest.description:
Digest over the source manifest (sorted relative paths + content
hashes). Same sources ⇒ same digest; any source change ⇒ different
digest. Empty when the manifest could not be computed.

workspace.description: Canonicalized workspace path the graph was built from.

EdgeInfo.description: A single edge in the build_graph response.

SkippedFileDto.description: F2.W8: per-file skipped-file record surfaced through `build_graph`.

basis.description:
PRF-ANA-06: identity of what the graph was built from.
`None` only when identity cannot be established at all;
otherwise present with `complete: false` when any component
(workspace canonicalization, manifest digest) is unavailable.

skipped_files.description:
F2.W8: files that could not be processed during the walk.
`None` when the graph was served from cache (no walk happened
on this call); `Some([])` when the walk finished with no
omissions; `Some([..])` when one or more files were dropped
because of I/O / parsing failures.

status.description:
PRF-ANA-04: explicit build outcome surfaced to the caller so
consumers (LLM, CI, alert) can branch on it without parsing
`skipped_files`. Values:
  - `"complete"`: walk happened, no skipped files.
  - `"partial"`: walk happened, at least one file was
    dropped (I/O or parsing failure).
  - `"unknown"`: served from the in-memory graph cache, no
    walk happened on this call.

name: get_file_symbols
description: Extract symbols (functions, classes, variables) from a source file. Set compressed=true for natural language summary. Set hierarchical=true for tree output.

compressed.description: Return compressed natural language summary instead of JSON (default: false)

hierarchical.description: Group symbols by nesting (parent→children tree) (default: false)

name: get_call_hierarchy
description: Traverse call graph to find callers (incoming) or callees (outgoing). Requires build_graph first.

name: analyze_impact
description: Analyze the impact of changing a symbol. Returns impacted files and risk level.

name: find_usages
description: Find all usages of a symbol across the project.

context_lines.description: Number of surrounding source lines to include per usage (default: none)

name: get_complexity
description: Calculate code complexity metrics (cyclomatic, cognitive, nesting).

name: get_entry_points
description: Find symbols with no incoming edges (entry points in the call graph). Requires build_graph first.

compressed.description: Return compressed natural language summary instead of JSON (default: false)

name: get_leaf_functions
description: Find symbols with no outgoing edges (leaf functions in the call graph). Requires build_graph first.

compressed.description: Return compressed natural language summary instead of JSON (default: false)

name: trace_path
description: Find execution path between two symbols using BFS.

all.description: If true, return ALL paths (BFS exhaustive). If false, return only the shortest path (default: false)

name: export_mermaid
description: Export call graph or subgraph as Mermaid flowchart. Optionally render to SVG with a theme.

root_symbol.description: Subgraph root symbol (optional - if not provided, exports entire graph)

name: get_hot_paths
description: Find functions with highest fan-in (most called functions).

limit.description: Number of hot paths to return (default: 10)

name: query_symbol_index
description: Query the symbol index to find locations of a symbol by name (case-insensitive).

directory.description: Directory to search in (default: current working directory)

name: build_call_subgraph
description: Build an on-demand call subgraph centered on a symbol.

directory.description: Directory to search in (default: current working directory)

symbol_name.description: Symbol name to build subgraph around

name: get_per_file_graph
description: Get the call graph for a specific file.

file_path.description: File path to get graph for

name: get_symbol_code
description: Get the full source code of a symbol at a given location, including docstrings.

name: go_to_definition
description: Navigate to the definition of a symbol using LSP.

name: hover
description: Get type information and documentation for a symbol at a position using LSP.

name: find_references
description: Find all references to a symbol using LSP.

name: read_file
description: Smart file reader with semantic modes.

end_line.description: End line for partial read (1-indexed, default: last line)

path.description: Path to the file to read (required)

start_line.description: Start line for partial read (1-indexed, default: 1)

name: search_content
description: Search file contents with .gitignore awareness.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around matches (default: 2)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

path.description: Path to search within (optional, defaults to workspace root)

regex.description: Whether to treat pattern as regex (default: true)

name: list_files
description: List project files with .gitignore awareness.

path.description: Path to list (optional, defaults to workspace root)

recursive.description: Whether to list files recursively (default: true)

name: retrieve_and_verify
description: Search for code matching a query and verify Rust files via sandboxed rustc compilation. Combines lexical search with compile-check verification.

language.description: Language filter (reserved for future use, defaults to 'rust')

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

verify.description: Whether to verify Rust files via rustc compilation (default: true)

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite files within the workspace.

create_dirs.description: Whether to create parent directories if they don't exist (default: false)

path.description: Path to the file to write (required)

name: edit_file
description: Edit files with syntax validation.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (required)

name: safe_refactor
description: Perform safe refactoring with validation and preview.

name: ask_about_code
description: Answer questions about code flow by tracing execution paths between symbols.

name: find_pattern_by_intent
description: Match natural language intent descriptions to known code patterns.

list_patterns.description: Whether to list all available patterns

name: nl_to_symbol
description: Convert natural language descriptions to symbol matches using keyword extraction and semantic search.

query.description: Natural language description of symbol to find

name: detect_god_functions
description: Find overly large or complex functions (god functions) that should be refactored.

name: detect_long_parameter_lists
description: Find functions with too many parameters that should be consolidated into structs.

name: generate_contract
description: Generate an AVC truth contract from an existing function. Returns syntax, semantic, and safety constraints.

file_path.description: Path to the source file containing the function

function_name.description: Name of the function to generate a contract for

name: validate_contract
description: Validate generated code against an AVC truth contract. Returns pass/fail with violations and fix suggestions.

contract_id.description: ID of the contract to validate against

name: graph_pagerank
description: Compute PageRank importance scores for all symbols in the call graph. Returns a ranked list of symbols by dependency importance. High-scoring symbols are 'god nodes' (heavily depended-upon). Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_all_paths
description: Find all simple paths between two symbols in the call graph. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_condensed
description: Compute the SCC condensation of the call graph: every strongly connected component is collapsed into a single node, producing an acyclic condensation DAG. Use to spot circular dependency clusters. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_god_nodes
description: Find god nodes — symbols with unusually high PageRank (above the supplied percentile). These are symbols that too many things depend on and are prime refactoring candidates. Requires build_graph first.

percentile.description: Percentile threshold in [0.0, 1.0] (default: 0.95). Symbols at or above this PageRank percentile are returned.

name: graph_reduced
description: Compute the transitive reduction of the call graph — the minimal set of dependency edges that preserves reachability. Redundant edges (implied by longer paths) are dropped. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_feedback_arcs
description: Find a feedback arc set — edges whose removal would make the call graph acyclic. The greedy heuristic is not optimal but fast; use the result as a starting point when breaking circular dependencies. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_communities
description: Detect code communities using Label Propagation. Groups symbols that are tightly coupled into clusters. Returns communities with cohesion scores. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_community_detail
description: Get details for a specific community detected by graph_communities (members, internal/external edge counts, cohesion score, and top god nodes within the community). Requires build_graph first.

community_id.description: Sequential community id from graph_communities output

max_iterations.description: Max label propagation iterations used to re-detect communities (default: 100)

name: graph_surprising_connections
description: Find surprising cross-community connections. These are edges between symbols in different communities, indicating unexpected coupling. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_search_idf
description: Search symbols ranked by IDF (Inverse Document Frequency) importance. Rare terms score higher. Includes hub bypass for cleaner results. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_insights
description: Get a complete architecture health report: god nodes, circular dependencies, community overview, surprising cross-module connections, and a health score (0-100). Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_suggest_questions
description: Generate intelligent questions about the codebase architecture based on graph analysis. Helps identify areas that need attention. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_query
description: Natural language graph topology query. Ask 'what connects X to Y?' and get a subgraph with provenance. Requires build_graph first.

max_depth.description: Maximum BFS depth from seed nodes (default: 3)

question.description: Natural language question about the graph topology

name: graph_explain
description: Composite deep-dive on a symbol: callers, callees, fan-in/out, complexity. Saves multiple tool calls. Requires build_graph first.

name: detect_drift
description: Analyze a source file for intent drift (S7000: docstring-body mismatch), AVC violations (S7001: unsafe/panic/unwrap), obsolete patterns (S7002: try! macro), and forbidden terms (S7003). Persists high-drift findings to the drift_events store.

file_path.description: Path to the source file to analyze (required)

function_name.description: Optional function name to scope analysis to a single function

threshold.description: Minimum drift score threshold (default: 0.5). Only findings with drift_score >= threshold are included.

name: get_type_references
description: List type annotation references for a symbol (param types, return types, field types). Uses References edges from type-ref extraction. Requires build_graph first.

name: get_imports
description: List all imports for a file. Uses Imports edges from the ingest pipeline. Requires build_graph first.

name: get_implementors
description: Find all types that implement a given trait/interface. Uses Implements edges. Requires build_graph first.

name: get_members
description: List methods and fields of a class/struct. Uses Contains edges. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_query_filtered
description: Graph query with provenance, node kind, and community filters. Requires build_graph first.

name: export_callflow
description: Export a community-level Mermaid architecture call-flow diagram. Shows module-level relationships.

name: solid_audit
description: Analyze code for SOLID principle violations (SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP). Returns violations with severity, location, and suggestions. Requires build_graph first.

name: graph_analyze
description: Run advanced graph algorithms: scc, reduced, or feedback_arcs.

name: project_overview
description: Get a comprehensive project overview at quick, medium, or detailed levels.

name: codebase_map
description: Generate a compact, LLM-optimized codebase map. Format: compact (~400 tokens) or detailed (~2000).

name: project_insights
description: Dashboard in a single call: symbols, edges, entry points, dead code, health score, hot paths.

dead_code.description: Dead code count (symbols with no callers/dependents).

hot_paths.description: Hot paths — top god node names ranked by importance score.

name: smart_search
description: Run semantic_search + ranked_symbols + graph_search_idf in parallel with deduplication. Returns merged results ranked by combined score.

name: check_architecture
description: Detect cycles and architecture violations using Tarjan SCC algorithm. Requires build_graph first.

scope.description: Optional scope to filter analysis (e.g., module name)

name: graph_checkpoint
description: Manage graph checkpoints: create (build+checkpoint), current (get latest), restore (get by id), list (list all). Requires build_graph first.

operation.description: Operation: create, current, restore, list (default: create)

name: merge_graphs
description: Merge per-file call graphs into a consolidated project graph.

file_paths.description: List of source file paths to merge

name: build_lightweight_index
description: Build a lightweight symbol index for fast lookups. Supports strategies: lightweight, on_demand, per_file, full.

name: reparse_on_edit
description: Incrementally reindex changed files without rebuilding the full graph. Much faster than full rebuild for small edits. Requires persistence feature.

file_paths.description: List of changed file paths to reindex

name: iac_query
description: Query infrastructure-as-code resources (Terraform, Ansible) and their dependencies from the graph. Requires build_graph first. Accepts bare resource names (aws_instance.web) or canonical IDs (tf:main.tf:aws_instance.web). Returns resource type, dependencies, and dependents. Uses the in-memory graph (ladybug persistence is wired at the runtime layer).

resource_id.description: Resource ID: bare name (aws_instance.web) or canonical (tf:main.tf:aws_instance.web)

name: review_pr
description: Analyze PR impact: provide changed files, get risk level, impacted files, and breaking changes.

name: list_view_specs
description: List all ViewSpecs visible to the current workspace (built-in + persisted runtime). Returns descriptors (id, title, is_builtin, source). Use read_view_spec to fetch the full 13-field JSON for any spec.

name: read_view_spec
description: Read a full ViewSpec by id (built-in kebab id like 'overview', 'call-graph'; or runtime UUID). Returns the complete 13-field ViewSpec JSON. Built-in specs synthesize with empty data_source/transform/props — use list_view_specs for discovery.

id.description: ViewSpec id (built-in kebab id or UUID)

name: cfg_per_function
description: Build the CFG (control flow graph) for one function given adjacency, root, and exits.

name: dominators_cfg
description: Compute per-function dominators over a CFG adjacency slice.

name: slice_forward
description: Forward slice from a (variable, definition_site) criterion.

name: slice_backward
description: Backward slice from a (variable, use_sites[]) criterion.

name: taint_flow
description: Forward taint analysis over a DFG (declarative Rust patterns).
